r.문화권·종교: Spanish-speaking · Catholic mixed with Afro-Cuban religions
r.경제 체제: State-planned economy · tourism, nickel, doctors sent abroad, US sanctions
r.한국이 파는 것: Cars 47%, Rice 42%, Machinery, computers 2% (2025, share of value)
r.한국이 사는 것: Copper 58%, Tobacco 17%, Other chemicals 16%, Aluminum 6% (2025, share of value)

t.why: It has been under a US economic embargo since the 1960s and is close to Russia and China.
t.rel: It broke off relations with the United States across the sea in 1961 and restored them in 2015, but the embargo remains. The US base at Guantanamo sits on the island's southeast. It has traded doctors for Venezuelan oil and is close to Russia and China.
t.korea: Korea and Cuba established diplomatic relations in 2024. Descendants of Korean immigrants who arrived via Mexico in the early 1900s live there.
t.know: Cuba and the United States broke off relations after the 1959 revolution and only reopened embassies in 2015.
t.etext: The state runs most of the economy. Tourism, nickel, tobacco and doctors sent abroad are its main sources of foreign currency. Long-standing US sanctions, power shortages and scarce goods make the economy difficult.
